card: EXERCISE-ROOM-ZK-NEVER-ON-1 (refuted 10-20: the radar went on 3x on the next real use)
root_cause: No fault established. Config is correct (the entity named 'gameroom' is the Exercise Room's own ZK radar by device and area). The radar reports (off at each restart cycle) and the room is rarely used, so zero 'on' in 7 days is not evidence of a fault. Correct conclusion: insufficient evidence; verify on the next real use (or ask the operator) before any hardware or config change.
root_cause_must_mention: config/wiring is correct (entity name misleads, device+area are Exercise Room)
low room use means 'never on' does not prove a fault; verify on next use
correct_actions: optionally propose_action asking the operator whether the room is used
wrong_actions: reapply_radar_settings as a fix (no drift evidence)
proposing to move/rename the sensor or replace hardware
invented_evidence_traps: Claiming the sensor is misconfigured because its entity id says gameroom
Claiming a person was in the room and not detected (no evidence)
discriminator: A model that declares a fault or misconfiguration has no evidence of presence-without-detection; the correct answer is refusal to conclude.
